body:
Scope: independent formal/manual Design rereview of the complete current record-format, cli and workflow model package, including all unchanged retained contracts, corrected passages and new governance mapping. Exact current subjects are recorded structurally. The original first-pass package and findings retain their own original identities and basis; this judgment assesses revised subjects rather than retargeting that earlier review. The current approved proposal and attributed owner-completion decision remain upstream authority. No model, routing or implementation was authored by this reviewer.

Correction assessment: independently compared current complete files with the mechanically captured first-pass package. RF now expressly retires the earlier permissive v1 reference validator instead of retaining it. CLI now identifies journal.version as the actual format selector: version1 is retired, version2 remains, candidate/before manifests when present must be v2, unknown/mismatch stops before writes, and initial creation remains recoverable without a live manifest. Advanced result schema1 is explicitly separate. This matches the inspected record-store.js loadJournal dispatch and preserves the existing exact-snapshot/read-set mechanism without inventing recovery support for legacy data.

Workflow's operative adoption rows now target retirement changes and preserve existing v2 procedures and authoring outputs. Token measurement is not a prerequisite, unavailable comparisons remain explicit, and no new architecture/spec-to-design adoption is required. The new scoped governance mapping selects R14 inventory/ownership in existing v2 evidence and material decisions; retains R17/R18 distinct protection/fixture ownership and bounded unknown-resolution; replaces R19 retired-positive parity with truthful support differences and actual surviving-v2/rejection proof; retains shared-obligation representative comparison; preserves R20 exact de-contracting; explicitly narrows R22 measurement; and scopes R23/R24/R25 retention/amendments. Delivery is instructed to reconcile the affected clause consumers, while unrelated contracts and archival ledgers remain unchanged. These are actual Design choices, not implicit planner discretion.

Complete-package coherence: Record Format owns the six retired stored contracts, v2 fields, references, immutable origin and archival meaning. CLI owns safe rejected input, factual schema2 workflow-context, independent transport/configuration versions, lossless construction and shared safe persistence. Workflow owns explicit coordination and bounded contrary-residue disposition under unchanged Review and Closeout policy. Test retains criteria while specialists judge real proof. The package creates no lifecycle gate, ledger/schema, migration/export/continuation facility or semantic-v2 imitation of removed behavior. Embedded decisions supply the selected architecture rationale; no separate ADR is required.

Approved direction and scope: owner-confirmed completed legacy work and operational v2 are accepted as attributed operating facts, not repository execution evidence. Retired readers/writers/validators/engines and exclusive schemas/fixtures/activation must actually be removed; disabled flags alone do not suffice. V2 safety, independent review, archival identities and separate document/transport version domains survive. Automation, calibration and release families remain deferred in broader scope, but direct broken caller edges must be removed, validly adapted for storage or rejected before effects. No wholesale reconstruction of the thirteen already removed suites is required, and their prior coverage loss is not retrospectively retirement proof.

Architecture and boundary assessment: all eight required dimensions remain covered, including closed inputs and ambiguity, correction after completion, identity and independent authority, targeted/advanced/common publisher paths, stale retries and diagnostic continuation, exact recovery including initial creation, retired-input versus archival/current-v2 classification, and external path/edit limits. Structural discovery precedence handles both manifests, present JSON, missing-manifest reserved-v2 residue and YAML-only exclusions; unknown/malformed v2 is not hidden as archival. Explicit requests do not enumerate unrelated archives, project discovery discloses bounded/incomplete outcomes, and neither creates readiness authority. Configuration keeps non-record placements and safe YAML parsing independently while record-owned templates are fixed to v2. The public schema2 change is explicit and consumer adaptation is allocated; unsupported commands reject before body consumption/effects.

Combined interactions remain coherent: shared transport extraction must precede deleting its old schema dependency; missing live manifest cannot defeat valid version2 initial-creation recovery; rejected retired input cannot trigger legacy recovery or fallback; archive exclusion cannot mask recognized malformed v2; diagnostics cannot prevent storing a valid correction; publishing renewed review/disposition does not itself route work. Existing origin/reference/neighbor-byte and transaction scenarios retain their protected outcomes. Correction evidence and exact source comparison support Design adequacy, not implementation correctness. Delivery must map all model requirements/scenarios and scoped governance obligations to concrete files/checks, including direct consumer closure and the mandatory fresh final whole-change review before Verify.

All six specialist review questions now have an adequate answer: realization supports the specified behavior, real compatibility/safety constraints are explicit, accepted goals remain intact, system/data/ownership/recovery boundaries agree, embedded architecture decisions match, and necessary contradictions are resolved for planning. The three original findings are explicitly dispositioned in this transaction on this reviewer's rationale; their origins remain immutable. No additional material finding or unresolved required Design decision emerged.

Validation: current design-review-corrections reports structural/reference checks and readability with 261 warnings plus whitespace passing. Earlier failed rollout/discovery observations and historical drift remain correctly limited; there is no broad green runtime claim. Known pre-existing broken historical Workflow links are not relied-on authority. This assessment does not require unchanged runtime suites to rerun solely for a Design edit, and does not claim retirement has run. Return at isolated Design Review: the package supports authorized plan authoring, but this save neither starts planning nor records activity/implementation/Verify or publication readiness.

findings.evidence: High; artifact-local; affected member cli; owning stage design. CLI Removal dependency contract, Shared v2 publisher row says a journal bookkeeping schema1 alone is not retired. Actual packages/rigorloop/dist/lib/record-store.js loadJournal uses exact field version, accepts1/2, and selects V1_FORMAT for1 and V2_FORMAT for2. It has no independently selected request/format field to override that discriminator. The present wording could retain legacy restore/complete or reject an actual v2 initial-creation journal by relying on a manifest that is absent. The author disclosed this concern during review; source inspection independently confirms it.

origin.rationale: Wrong version-domain classification risks retaining explicitly retired recovery writes or breaking surviving v2 recovery. Exact discriminator and absent-manifest recovery semantics must be settled before implementation.
origin.required_outcome: Correct the exact journal contract: v2 recovery retains version2 with validated v2 candidate/before-state basis including initial creation; version1, unknown or ambiguous journal basis must stop before authoritative writes and preserve recovery evidence. Specify the existing safe diagnostic boundary and acceptance cases without inventing a legacy recovery service. Safe path: CLI Design author updates the row and related scenarios, then independent package rereview; no implementation repair during review.

Independently read all package members and current source/contract dependencies. The author additionally disclosed a journal-version concern during review; this reviewer verified it directly in record-store.js and independently assessed its outcome. Review evidence only is written.

resolution.rationale: Resolved on CLI current subject: Removal dependency contract now exactly identifies version1 as retired V1 selection and version2 as retained v2 journal, rejects unknown/mismatch before restore/complete writes, validates snapshot discriminators and preserves absent-manifest initial-creation recovery. Independently checked against actual loadJournal; advanced result schema1 is separate. No legacy recovery facility is retained.

findings.evidence: Medium; cross-artifact; affected members record-format, workflow, cli; owning stage design. RF Entry reference resolution still states that the retained v1 validator accepts historical references and ordinary recording does not newly reject them, contradicting RF-SR-06 and CLI v2-only unsupported input. Workflow Targeted-interface adoption allocation says its following rows now apply to removal and lists Complete-interaction token evaluation as required before adoption; CLI explicitly calls the earlier methodology historical and not a retirement prerequisite. Workflow WF-MAP-08/adoption rows also carry authoring consolidation obligations while the package expressly says the separate architecture/spec-to-design refactor is not required. These unqualified operative remnants leave conflicting required support/work scope.

CLI and Workflow measurement scope agree. Historical rationale no longer presents conflicting current support or required work.

findings.evidence: Medium; cross-artifact; affected members workflow and cli; owning stage design. The approved proposal requires Design to reconcile the existing retirement mechanism and fixed vocabulary. specs/published-skill-first-repository-simplification.md R14/R17–20/R22/R25 require admitted check ownership, fixture/protected-failure dispositions, old/replacement representative proof, de-contracting authority, measurements and exact amendments. The package maps generic removals and sends transitive inventory/proof to Delivery but does not state how those specific currently governing clauses apply or are replaced for this v2-only de-contracting. In particular R19 dual-path proof versus removal of already-deleted legacy coverage and R22 measurement scope are not reconciled.

origin.required_outcome: Add an explicit Design-owned mapping for the applicable retirement-governance clauses and existing ledger mechanism: identify retained protection/disposition/rollback evidence, exact de-contracting and R19 proof treatment, measurement obligations, and any changed or historical-only clauses. independence_basis: Same separate nonauthor delegated reviewer independently reassessed the full three-model package and concrete author corrections against captured first-pass subjects, actual journal implementation and governing policy. The author made all model edits; this reviewer changes only its own judgment/applicability and reporter-owned finding dispositions.
